location.zh: （三周年活动「龙族大浩劫·布里克VS帕罗狄亚」）

capture.zh: 2012年4月29日13:00-14:00 三周年庆「龙族大浩劫」中的「布里克VS帕罗狄亚」对决（形式参照「天马VS阿洛比斯」）：玩家帮助龙族守卫军（布里克）攻打念力之王帕罗狄亚，击败后获得精元，合成/孵化得到初级形态帕罗。

strategy_notes.zh: 未找到同期具体打法；飞行超能系，被电、冰、暗影（对超能）系克制。

engine_notes: Story: 帕罗狄亚's clan was to be sealed by the old dragon king; 龙王子哈莫雷特 later makes amends. The event was a one-hour server-wide face-off; some sources say every kill gave a 精元 fragment and 'enough' of them made 帕罗 — count unknown, so one essence per win is used.

Rules, skills and HP are NOT published in any source found; 5000 HP and the top learnset skills are placeholders. Level 30: the 4399 2012-04-29 live report says the essence fights from the 40th minute were Lv30 (the first round was Lv100).
source_note: 4399 帕罗狄亚 图鉴: obtained in the 4月29日13-14点 小布VS帕罗狄亚 event; no battle data published.
